searchText: hey this may sound like a dumb question but what data is placed in a block when a gas token is minted? is it just the entirety of the contract created in the minting process? normally you need to execute transaction to determine that gas tokens were minted. Because call to the `mint` function can happen from other contracts. Currently, minting both GasToken2 and CHI both result in creation of small contracts with some standard bytecode. You can use this bytecode as a "recognition pattern", at least that's what I was planning to do
